name: Check current production API and authorization service
description: Shows three real successful API responses and the authorization service status through the recovery route.
expected: Both runs show API 1/3: OK, API 2/3: OK, API 3/3: OK and Авторизация: HTTP 200.

name: Preserve production login and deny empty credentials
description: Loads the current production sign-in screen and keeps business data inaccessible without credentials.
steps: Open / in a fresh browser session
Wait for Вход по логину and the login/password fields
Confirm the production loader pwa-register.js and eager.bundle.js load without failed asset requests.
Click Войти with both fields empty
expected: The login form stays visible with required-field validation. No authenticated dashboard or real order list is shown. Do not supply or guess credentials. The complete production loader is included; do not substitute the startup shell for the full application.

name: Unavailable production stops launch and exposes retry
description: An unavailable upstream produces a visible recovery error with a retry action.
expected: The page shows Не удалось открыть резервный вход and a Повторить button again, without showing private business data.
